title: KofiMania
summary: Kofi Kingston’s unexpected title opportunity becomes a fan-backed championship campaign. Daniel Bryan is the champion he must overcome, with The New Day behind him.

chapters.title: Kingston comes close in the Chamber
chapters.result: Daniel Bryan retains, last eliminating Kofi Kingston.
chapters.context: Kingston’s performance strengthens the demand for another opportunity.

chapters.title: Kingston becomes WWE champion
chapters.context: The New Day celebrates the culmination of Kingston’s championship pursuit.
